title: Responsive UI Layout on Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile
description: Verify that the website layout adjusts correctly and remains fully functional across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

steps.description: Open the website homepage on a desktop browser.
Check that all UI components are visible, properly aligned, and functional with no scroll or overlap issues.
Resize the browser to tablet dimensions (e.g., 768px width).
Verify the layout adjusts using flexbox/grid properly; no horizontal scroll or broken UI.
Open the website on a mobile device or emulated mobile viewport.
Confirm the mobile menu, buttons, and text are legible and all interactive elements are accessible.

title: Language Toggle Functionality
description: Validate that the language toggle correctly switches all UI text elements between Korean and English.

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage.
Set interface language to Korean using the language toggle.
Verify all visible UI text (menu, buttons, headings) is displayed in Korean.
Switch language toggle to English.
Verify all UI text switches accurately and completely to English.

title: Hero Carousel Auto and Manual Sliding
description: Ensure the hero image carousel automatically cycles every 5 seconds and responds properly to manual sliding controls, restarting the timer.

steps.description: Open the homepage and observe the hero carousel.
Confirm the carousel automatically advances to the next slide every 5 seconds.
Click the next and previous manual controls.
Check the slide changes immediately and auto-slide timer resets without skipping slides.

title: Inquiry Form Client-side Validation
description: Verify that invalid user inputs are blocked on the client side before form submission for the inquiry form.

steps.description: Navigate to the inquiry submission form.
Leave mandatory fields empty and attempt to submit the form.
Confirm form submission is blocked and appropriate validation messages are shown.
Enter invalid formats (e.g., malformed email) and try to submit.
Check that submission is blocked and error messages are displayed.

title: Inquiry Form Server-side Validation and Storage
description: Test that inquiry form data is validated on the server and stored securely with password hashing.

steps.description: Submit a valid inquiry with all required fields filled.
Verify server accepts the data and responds with success.
Attempt to submit inquiry with malicious input (e.g., script tags).
Confirm server rejects input or sanitizes to prevent XSS.
Review database storage for the inquiry password to ensure it is hashed.
Validate that password is not stored in plaintext.

title: Public Inquiry Board Listing and Masked User Names
description: Verify public inquiry board loads correctly with user names masked for privacy.

steps.description: Navigate to public inquiry board page.
Confirm inquiries are listed with user names partially masked (e.g., first character plus asterisks).
Use 'Load More' feature repeatedly until no more inquiries are available.
Ensure inquiries load progressively and the feature disables or hides at the end.

title: Inquiry Detail View with Password Protection
description: Test that viewing inquiry details requires password input and grants access only for correct passwords.

steps.description: Select an inquiry from the public board and attempt to view details.
Verify that a password prompt modal appears.
Submit an incorrect password.
Confirm access is denied with a proper error message.
Submit the correct password.
Check that the detailed inquiry content is displayed.

title: MSDS Board Search and Pagination
description: Confirm MSDS board keyword search filters results accurately and pagination works smoothly.

steps.description: Navigate to MSDS board page.
Enter a search keyword and submit.
Verify displayed MSDS posts match the search criteria.
Use pagination controls to navigate through search result pages.
Confirm smooth paging with corresponding updated results.

title: MSDS Detail View and View Count Increment
description: Validate MSDS detail page loads correctly and increments view count unless viewed in admin edit mode.

steps.description: Open an MSDS post detail view as a public user.
Check that detailed content is shown along with an embedded Google Drive button.
Record current view count for the MSDS post.
Refresh or re-open the detail page.
Verify the view count has incremented by one.
Open the same MSDS detail in admin edit mode.
Confirm view count does not increment during admin editing.

title: Admin Login with Correct and Incorrect Passwords
description: Test admin login succeeds with the correct password issuing JWT, and fails appropriately with wrong credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the admin login page.
Input a correct admin password and submit.
Verify login is successful and a JWT token is received.
Log out and attempt login with an incorrect password.
Verify login is denied with an appropriate error message and no token issued.

title: Admin Dashboard Inquiry Management CRUD
description: Verify admin can view, reply to, and delete inquiries with actions reflected in the UI and database.

steps.description: Log into admin dashboard.
Navigate to the inquiries management tab and view inquiry list.
Confirm inquiries are displayed correctly.
Select an inquiry and submit a reply.
Verify the reply is saved and visible in UI and database.
Delete an inquiry using the dashboard control.
Confirm the inquiry is removed from UI and no longer present in the database.

title: Admin Dashboard MSDS Post CRUD Operations
description: Ensure the admin can create, update, and delete MSDS posts and that changes are correctly reflected in the system.

steps.description: Log into admin dashboard.
Navigate to the MSDS management tab.
Create a new MSDS post with valid data and save.
Verify the new post appears in the list and in the database.
Edit an existing MSDS post's title and content.
Confirm the updates are displayed in the UI and persisted.
Delete an MSDS post.
Validate the post is removed from UI and database.

title: Backend API Input Validation and Error Handling
description: Confirm backend API endpoints properly validate inputs and return appropriate status codes and error messages for both success and failure cases.

steps.description: Call each API endpoint with valid input data.
Verify the response status is success (200 or 201) and correct data is returned.
Call the same API endpoints with invalid inputs, missing required fields, or malformed data.
Check that response status indicates client error (400 series) with detailed JSON error messages.
Test error scenarios such as unauthorized access to protected endpoints without JWT.
Confirm 401 or 403 status codes with relevant messages are returned.

title: Admin Authentication JWT Security and Role-based Access
description: Verify that JWT tokens are securely issued on login and enforce role-based access controls on protected routes.

steps.description: Log in as admin and obtain JWT token.
Check the token is a valid JWT with correct claims excluding password data.
Use JWT token to access protected admin API endpoints.
Verify successful access is granted.
Attempt to access admin endpoints without a JWT or with invalid token.
Confirm access is denied with appropriate error status.

title: Data Sanitization against XSS Attacks
description: Verify all user inputs are properly sanitized on backend APIs to prevent cross-site scripting attacks.

steps.description: Submit user input containing script or HTML tags in inquiry and MSDS content fields.
Check the stored data is sanitized and rendered safely without executing scripts.
Retrieve content and verify safe encoding on display.
Confirm that no XSS or unsafe HTML is present in UI or database.

title: Environment Variable Security for Sensitive Keys
description: Ensure that sensitive keys and passwords are stored securely in environment variables and not exposed in logs or source code.

steps.description: Inspect deployed backend environment for presence of JWT secret and database credentials as environment variables.
Confirm that sensitive keys are not hardcoded or exposed in source code, logs, or UI.
